overview.Name: JBG SMITH Properties
overview.Description: JBG SMITH Properties owns, operates, and develops mixed-use properties concentrated in amenity-rich, Metro-served submarkets. The markets are in and around Washington, DC, most notably National Landing, where through our focus on placemaking, they cultivate vibrant, highly amenitized, walkable neighborhoods. JBG SMITH Properties has a portfolio comprised of 12.0 million square feet at share of multifamily, office, and retail assets, and a 3.6 million square-foot development pipeline. JBG SMITH Properties was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Bethesda, United States.
